selection_reason: reuse the four complete Pro reliability pools; two ordinary and two complex-ring development cases, not a blind sample
threshold_role: 9 degrees is the focal exploratory setting; compare full layouts before choosing a working threshold
vote_rule: at_least_half_of_all_current_records; one worker at most once per endpoint identity
center_rule: unchanged pair-distance-medoid anchored periodic x and endpoint coordinate medians; no GT fitting
hybrid_scope: single endpoint establishes identity; original paired partners estimate the other end; both symmetric anchors reported, no adaptive winner selection
split_pairing: threshold top/bottom identity supports separately; selected identity bipartite graph uses original pair incidence; output complete pairs only if graph is one-to-one with no isolated selected identity; do not demand joint majority
split_x: shortest-periodic midpoint of matched endpoint centers; record each output adjustment; half-turn ambiguity unavailable; no source preprocessing changes
connection: reuse exploratory center-x ring and original adjacency diagnostics; generated rings unconfirmed, complex source rings not reordered
evaluation: save all constructed candidates before reading fixed original references; report BEV plus upper/lower continuous longitude differences where applicable, failures and unavailable metrics explicitly
